_comment: Advisories accepted for this dev-only toolchain. Each entry expires; the gate fails after the date so the exception is re-decided, not forgotten. package-lock.json is sealed into the audited release bundle (audit/launch-2026-09-18/tokoin-candidate-bundle.json), so `npm audit fix` here breaks bundle:verify and needs a new external audit decision.

advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion validating oversized collections (<4.6.6). Reached only through hardhat 3.x / hardhat-zod-utils (latest hardhat 3.21 still requires zod ^3), which validate the local hardhat config, never untrusted input. No non-breaking fix exists.
DoS on excessive content-encodings. Used by hardhat-utils for RPC to the local devnet only; the fix (6.29.1) changes the sealed lockfile. Re-decide when the bundle is re-bound.
Credential headers kept on cross-origin redirect. Dev toolchain only; local devnet runs send no credentials to redirecting hosts. The fix changes the sealed lockfile.
sensitiveHeaders regex escaping. Same scope and constraint as GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8.
